sections.name: Rivalry Mode

sections.description_summary: After Pandora is defeated, the box remains indestructible and unaffected, recovers Energy and can cast Panic Projection again without its HP-loss effect. It also casts Tainted Tribute on a random enemy every 5 seconds.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: The ally pulled into Pandora's box is permanently protected by hope and becomes immune to Panic Projection, even after Pandora is defeated.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening ranged-damage bonus to the ally one tile behind Pandora; higher ranks grant that ally a shield the first time their HP falls below 50%.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: The first ally below 40% HP is healed and shielded; refine adds Healing and Haste.

sections.name: Wild Shift
sections.description_summary: Immobilizes two rearmost enemies, teleports them to a target tile and drops them, damaging and knocking down enemies there. Each skill has a 20% chance to go out of control, teleporting its target to a random enemy-side location.

sections.name: Mad Missiles
sections.description_summary: Fires 9–12 magic missiles in quick succession; if out of control, missiles may hit random targets, including allies.

sections.name: Botanical Woe
sections.description_summary: Summons plants in the area with the most enemies, damaging enemies and reducing their Energy each second.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; after four skill casts without going out of control, grants more Haste.

sections.name: Mage's Bloom
sections.description_summary: The first cast of each skill cannot go out of control; each skill has a chance to mutate, adding area true damage and immobilization around the target.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: When Wild Shift mutates, the target tile enemy is immobilized and the two teleported enemies take extra max-HP-based damage when they land.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening damage and Haste bonus for 12 seconds; higher ranks restore HP and extend the effect after assisting or defeating a non-summoned enemy.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Ultimate casts grant a temporary damage dealt bonus; the first Ultimate also permanently increases Energy recovery from attacking. Refine adds Crit and Crit DMG Boost.

sections.name: Thunder Swordwork
sections.description_summary: Selects a tile and launches seven Swift Strikes at it and adjacent tiles, then grants Invigoration for 12 seconds and increases ATK.

sections.name: Unseen Blade
sections.description_summary: Strikes a target three times; during Invigoration, each strike also creates forked lightning that damages the target and up to two nearby enemies.

sections.name: Fury Thunder Strike
sections.description_summary: Casts only when Valen gains Invigoration and damages all enemies within 2 tiles.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK.

sections.name: Eternal Thunder
sections.description_summary: Grants permanent Invigoration. Casting Thunder Swordwork while invigorated permanently stacks ATK, up to 10 stacks. Higher level adds lightning to normal attacks.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Fury Thunder Strike stuns for 3 seconds. LV 2 grants 500 initial Energy; lightning hits restore Energy and reduce the target's Haste and movement speed.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases Crit; critical hits cause splash damage to nearby enemies. Higher ranks convert some critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken at battle start, then increases damage dealt after 20 seconds; refine adds Haste and DEF Penetration.

sections.name: Grand Finale
sections.description_summary: Builds beats over time and gains ATK/Haste when the score is complete. Active cast glides to the area with the most enemies, damages them, creates a Harmonic Domain, silences enemies inside and makes Sylphira unaffected while inside. Musical phrases also reduce target max HP.

sections.name: Punishing Rhythm
sections.description_summary: Three rhythmic hits deal damage and reduce the target's Energy.

sections.name: Piercing Silence
sections.description_summary: Controls an enemy, then deals area damage and knocks down nearby enemies; Sylphira is immune to control while casting.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; each beat lit adds Haste and score activation grants another Haste bonus.

sections.name: Harmonic Refrain
sections.description_summary: Once the score is activated, automatically plays every 8 seconds, removes dispellable debuffs, restores HP and Energy, and speeds up the score/increases Haste as more beats are collected. Higher level damages nearby enemies based on max HP.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: After the score activates, Tremolo enhances normal attacks with Life Drain and target-max-HP-based true damage.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken; both bonuses are amplified while on the enemy side. Higher ranks grant a permanent shield on first entry to enemy territory.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Opening, assist or defeat grants Penetration and Haste; refine adds Crit and Ranged DEF.

sections.name: Scared Swamp
sections.description_summary: Hides beneath an enemy's shadow, dealing repeated damage and absorbing Energy; then jumps out to damage and frighten adjacent enemies. Berial is invincible while hidden.

sections.name: Shadow Trick
sections.description_summary: Hides and becomes invincible; if isolated enemies exist, moves to each and damages them. Otherwise stays hidden and recovers HP before returning to his original tile.

sections.name: Devil's Contract
sections.description_summary: After defeat, hides in shadow for 10 seconds. If a non-summoned enemy is defeated during that time, Berial revives with a percentage of HP; once per battle.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage dealt by an isolated enemy and increases the damage they take.

sections.name: Shadow Reflection
sections.description_summary: Isolated non-summoned enemies lose Energy and generate a Silhouette with inherited stats. Silhouettes lose HP over time and attack only with normal attacks.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Extends hiding after defeat; LV 2 reduces the per-enemy summon cooldown, increases Energy loss and eventually removes Silhouette HP decay.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK when displaced by own skills; higher ranks add a shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Opening, assist or defeat grants Penetration and Haste; refine adds DEF Penetration and Execution.

sections.name: Living Armor - Kensuke
sections.description_summary: Summons slow-moving Living Armor with infinite HP and its own Energy pool. It loses Energy over time and from damage, then recharges and returns to combat. Recasting restores its Energy, grants control immunity and increases its ATK SPD.

sections.name: Intimidate
sections.description_summary: Confuses enemies in three adjacent tiles in front, preventing movement/actions and reducing Phys & Magic DEF. Confusion lasts longer against monsters.

sections.name: Dungeon Gourmet
sections.description_summary: When an enemy monster is defeated, collects an ingredient and restores Energy/HP. Laios cooks for nearby allies, healing and increasing ATK; each ingredient can add random extra buffs to nearby allies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Laios's ATK.

sections.name: Ingredient Analysis
sections.description_summary: At battle start, if monsters are present, analyzes them to cause extra ingredient drops at HP-loss thresholds. Higher levels increase damage to monsters and grant DEF per ingredient collected.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Each different ingredient collected using Dungeon Gourmet permanently increases Laios's max HP, up to three times.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK and Phys & Magic DEF for Laios and units he creates; higher ranks add Haste after 5 seconds.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken at battle start, then increases damage dealt after 20 seconds; refine adds Healing and Crit Resist.

sections.name: Omen's Grasp
sections.description_summary: Baden and all phantoms attack a designated enemy in four successive strikes, keeping it stunned. Final strike deals true damage to the target and enemies within 1 tile, drains HP, reduces max HP and prevents HP/Energy recovery for 8 s. Baden is invincible while casting.

sections.name: Wraithbrand
sections.description_summary: Opening curse damages enemies in a straight line. When a cursed non-Boss enemy first falls below 50% HP, a phantom appears nearby; Boss enemies summon phantoms each time they lose HP equal to a threshold based on Baden's initial ATK. Phantoms inherit stats, remain invincible and attack their summoning target. Active cast stuns the current target, steals max HP and Energy, then damages them.

sections.name: Soul Sunder
sections.description_summary: Baden and phantoms unleash five slashes. Final shockwave damages enemies within 2 tiles and reduces their Vitality, stacking up to three times.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Penetration, with extra Penetration while any phantom Baden created is on the battlefield.

sections.name: Revenant's Due
sections.description_summary: Opening Wraithbrand curse deals increased damage with guaranteed critical and max-HP reduction; each phantom summoned by the curse steals target ATK for Baden and itself.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: If Baden is defeated while any phantom remains, possesses one, is deprioritized by enemies and takes reduced damage for 8 s; up to three triggers per battle.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken, amplified on enemy side; higher ranks grant a permanent shield on first entry to enemy territory.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Opening/assist/defeat grants Penetration and Haste; refine adds Crit and Ranged DEF.

sections.name: Seed Siphon
sections.description_summary: Teleports in front of an enemy, prevents movement/actions, deals damage and drains Energy, then plants a Drain Seed. Seeds periodically damage their host and reduce Energy. Up to eight seeds can exist at once.

sections.name: Crimson Claim
sections.description_summary: Passive converts some damage from Saida's normal attacks and skills into healing, with excess healing becoming a shield. Active cast pierces an enemy, damages and interrupts them; nearby Drain Seeds also create blood spikes against the same target.

sections.name: Revenant Sprout
sections.description_summary: When defeated, consumes a Drain Seed to revive at its location and restore HP. Prioritizes the oldest seed; restored HP scales with seed age, subject to caps.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken; additional reduction scales with the number of existing Drain Seeds, up to a cap.

sections.name: Deepening Roots
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage dealt by enemies afflicted with Drain Seed and shortens the interval between seed attacks each time Saida casts her Ultimate. At max interval reduction, deals large damage to all enemies and traps them, preventing movement/actions while causing periodic HP loss.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Plants Drain Seeds on two nearby allies at battle start; allied seeds do not harm them and instead grant shields.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates increases ATK. Higher ranks add true damage to all enemies on each Ultimate.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Opening/assist/defeat grants Penetration and Haste; refine adds Ranged DEF and DEF Penetration.

sections.name: Divine Rend
sections.description_summary: Marches three tiles in a chosen direction, repeatedly damaging and knocking back adjacent enemies, then performs a shield bash that damages and stuns enemies within 1 tile. Perseus is unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Spear-Shield Combo
sections.description_summary: Circular spear and shield strikes damage adjacent enemies; shield strike grants a shield based on ATK and damage dealt, and increases Perseus's ATK SPD while it lasts.

sections.name: Fertile Ground
sections.description_summary: Before Perseus takes heavy damage, creates fertile ground within 1 tile. Allies standing on it gain ATK and Phys & Magic DEF. The first time Perseus falls below 40% of initial max HP, permanently increases his max HP and heals him; fertile ground then withers permanently.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK, with additional ATK while Perseus has temporary stat buffs from allies.

sections.name: Divine Grace
sections.description_summary: Each temporary stat buff increases its effect and grants damage dealt/damage taken modifiers, stacking up to four times. With two temporary stat buffs from different allies, damage becomes true damage and Perseus becomes unaffected for at least 6 s.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Expands Fertile Ground range by 1 tile.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken; both bonuses are amplified while on the enemy side. Higher ranks grant a permanent shield on first entry to enemy territory.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken at battle start, then increases damage dealt after 20 s; refine adds Crit Resist and Crit DMG DEF.

source_notes: Stargazer explicitly defines a temporary stat buff as an in-battle stat increase that expires by timer or condition. Shields, control immunity and damage dealt/taken modifiers do not count toward Divine Grace's trigger.
